# ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io Daily Update (May 13, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw a new pull request for a circulating supply rehearsal and significant activity on several long-standing issues, particularly around flaky tests and interop verification.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS
No new features, bug fixes, code refactoring, documentation enhancements, or tests were added today.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- A new pull request, [#1314](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1314), titled "[DRY RUN] Circulating supply rehearsal," was opened. This PR is likely related to preparing for or testing mechanisms for tracking circulating supply.

## CLOSED ISSUES
- **L2CM Retroactive Improvements Closed**: Two issues related to the L2CM retroactive project were closed. [#20389](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20389) concerning invariant definitions was closed as it's part of a larger discussion. [#20388](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20388) on Go vs. EVM and Gas Accounting issues was closed, with documentation improvements completed and global gas accounting changes deferred for further investigation.
- **Vulnerable Interop Activation Block Transition Addressed**: Issue [#20684](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20684), which highlighted a vulnerability where Kona accepted an invalid interop activation-block transition, was closed. The issue has been addressed in a related PR, ensuring consistent behavior across op-program, kona-client, and op-supernode.

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were opened today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES
- **SuperDisputeGame Deployment Progress**: Issue [#19652](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19652) discusses supporting the deployment of `SuperDisputeGame` via `op-deployer` and `netchef`. The latest comment suggests that the task is largely complete, as a devnet was successfully deployed to `PermissionedSuperDisputeGame`, and the upgrade to `SuperDisputeGame` has also been done.
- **Flaky Test: `TestFollowSource_HeadsDivergeThenConverge` Resurfaces**: Issue [#19821](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19821) regarding a flaky test has been reopened. The test, `TestFollowSource_HeadsDivergeThenConverge`, resurfaced with a different signature, now showing a convergence timeout on `memory-all-opn-op-reth` where the local-safe head never catches up to cross-safe. The EL (op-reth) appears stuck in `SYNCING`, causing the CL to reset repeatedly.
- **Flaky Test: `TestFlashblocksTransfer` Continues to Flake**: Issue [#19934](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19934) reports continued flakiness for `TestFlashblocksTransfer`. The latest comment indicates another failure, with the error "Alice's transfer never confirmed on the sequencer EL within 1m0s — likely a sequencer or txpool issue, not a flashblock issue." This suggests that while a previous PR improved failure reporting, the underlying `op-rbuilder` flashblock-emission bug persists.
- **Interop + Batcher: Use Verification-Aware CurrentL1**: Issue [#19944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19944) discusses the batcher's reliance on `CurrentL1` and its interaction with `op-supernode` during L1 reorgs. Recent comments clarify that the batcher's logic is designed for sequencer restarts, not L1 reorgs, and that the `currentL1` getting stuck at a zero block reference is the core problem, pointing to `op-node` / `op-supernode` as the source of the issue rather than the batcher. A related PR [#20694](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20694) is in progress.
- **`op-supernode`: Cross-Safe Head Stalls After Deep L1 Reorg**: Issue [#20134](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20134) describes a scenario where `op-supernode`'s cross-safe and local-safe heads permanently stall after a deep L1 reorg. The latest comment suggests that the fix should be in `op-node` / `op-supernode` rather than the batcher, linking to issue [#19944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19944).
- **Flaky Test: `TestWithdrawal_Permissioned`**: Issue [#20345](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20345) reports `TestWithdrawal_Permissioned` as flaky. The test continues to fail, with recent instances running for over 20 minutes before failing.
- **L2CM Retro: Group 4 Deferred**: Issue [#20390](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20390) for L2CM retro Group 4 has been deferred. The items, including running e2e tests on real clients and against forked blockchains, are considered future work and not high enough priority to block the current L2CM project completion.
